scientific.integrity: The proof substitutes the scalar trust-normalized LAMB update and uses induction on the invariant iterate sign. Moment magnitudes cancel algebraically; no asymptotic approximation is used.
limitations: One scalar layer, zero weight decay, and identity layer scaling are assumed.
Learning rates are strictly between zero and one so no minimizer crossing occurs.
Trust-ratio clipping and clipped layer-scaling functions can break the exact identity.
Multidimensional layer directions retain adaptive-moment dependence.

title: Exact scalar hyperparameter erasure in LAMB identity trust scaling
